en: Six months ago, I was the future.

en: These days, the polls say I got mocked by an anime girl.
zh: 这些天，民意调查显示我被一个动漫女孩嘲笑了。

en: You know, I get questions like this almost every day.
zh: 你知道，我几乎每天都有这样的问题。

en: Usually, I ignore it.
zh: 通常，我会忽略它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Or I give the media answer.
zh: 或者我给媒体一个回答。

en: Today, you get some real ones.

en: You came for loops, graphs, making Codex go brrr.

en: This is free on my Twitter.

en: This will help you to survive the roller coaster that might be coming for you.
zh: 这将帮助你在可能迎面而来的过山车中生存下来。

en: You know, yesterday, Boris told you to let the model cook.
zh: 你知道，昨天，Boris 告诉你要让模型去烹饪。

en: I'm the guy who found out what happened
zh: 我是那个发现了发生了什么的人

en: When tens of thousands of people let it cook at the same time.

en: Let's start with the question everyone asks first.
zh: 让我们从每个人首先问的问题开始。

speaker: Unknown
en: How is OpenClaw only eight months old?
zh: OpenClaw 怎么才八个月大？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it might be eight months in human time, but in AI times, it's more like four years.
zh: 你知道，按人类时间可能是八个月，但在 AI 时间里，更像四年。

speaker: Unknown
en: And my source of inspiration is usually being annoyed.
zh: 我的灵感来源通常是被惹恼。

speaker: Unknown
en: So on a rainy day in November, I was chuckling some agents, but I was also hungry.
zh: 所以在十一月的一个雨天，我正在 Chuckle 一些智能体，但我也饿了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I want to make sure that my tokens are put to good use.
zh: 所以我想确保我的 tokens 被好好利用。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I raid the kitchen.
zh: 于是我突袭了厨房。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there was still no good way to just send a prompt from my phone to my computer.
zh: 但仍然没有好的方法可以从我的手机向我的电脑发送一个提示词。

speaker: Unknown
en: So some agent could check up how my agent's actually doing.
zh: 这样一些智能体可以检查我的智能体实际表现如何。

speaker: Unknown
en: Remember early 2025?
zh: 还记得 2025 年初吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And you guys, this is my first silent disco.
zh: 你们各位，这是我的第一次无声迪斯科。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a very new experience.
zh: 这是一个非常新的体验。

speaker: Unknown
en: So give me some hands if you actually listen to me.
zh: 如果你真的在听我说，请举一下手。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amazing.
zh: 太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Amazing.
zh: 太棒了。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, early 2025, oh my God, we're talking the old Opus 3, Gemini 2.5.
zh: 你知道，2025 年初，天哪，我们在说旧时的 Opus 3，Gemini 2.5。

speaker: Unknown
en: OpenAI had 03, which was the most impressive one, but also really slow and expensive at times.
zh: OpenAI 有 03，那是最令人印象深刻的，但也真的很慢而且有时很贵。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I got a dopamine hit when my agent did something right.
zh: 当我的智能体做对了什么时，我得到了多巴胺刺激。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sure you remember this time.
zh: 我相信你们记得这段时期。

speaker: Unknown
en: And these days, if they get something wrong,
zh: 而这些天，如果它们做错了什么，

speaker: Unknown
en: I usually question myself.
zh: 我通常会质疑我自己。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did I design the loop wrong?
zh: 我是不是把循环设计错了？

speaker: Unknown
en: Did I not give my agent everything they need to verify their work?
zh: 我是不是没有给我的智能体提供它们验证工作所需的一切？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do I have an error in my thinking?
zh: 我的思维里有错误吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Am I asking for impossible things?
zh: 我是在要求不可能的事情吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So I came back from the kitchen and my coding agent stopped because of something silly.
zh: 所以我从厨房回来了，我的编码智能体因为一些愚蠢的事情停止了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was annoyed.
zh: 我很恼火。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I spun up a new terminal session.
zh: 所以我开启了一个新的终端会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: I rambled my idea in, and I let the model cook.
zh: 我把我的想法嘟囔进去，我让模型去烹饪。

speaker: Unknown
en: It built me a WhatsApp relay.
zh: 它给我建了一个 WhatsApp 中继。

speaker: Unknown
en: And an hour later, I could send messages from my Mac to WhatsApp and back.
zh: 一小时后，我可以从我的 Mac 发消息到 WhatsApp 并回传。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that in itself felt magical.
zh: 这本身感觉很神奇。

speaker: Unknown
en: But really, it shouldn't have.
zh: 但实际上，不应该如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, we all did this for months already, right?
zh: 就像，我们都这么做已经好几个月了，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: We opened the terminal.
zh: 我们打开了终端。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you type something in and you get a reply.
zh: 你输入一些东西，然后你会得到一个回复。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the magic is how it felt.
zh: 但神奇之处在于它的感觉。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wasn't a terminal.
zh: 它不是一个终端。

speaker: Unknown
en: It wrote concise answers.
zh: 它写出了简洁的回答。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was proactive.
zh: 它是主动的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like sometimes it would just like check on me during the day.
zh: 有时候它甚至会在白天查看我的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: I made it sort of...
zh: 我把它弄得有点……

speaker: Unknown
en: The complexity would melt away.
zh: 复杂性会消融。

speaker: Unknown
en: You don't have to think about which model, which context size, or when you start a new session.
zh: 你不需要考虑是哪个模型，哪个上下文大小，或者什么时候开始一个新的会话。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I prompted the weights to, a little bit outside the default distribution, make it feel more like a friend.
zh: 而且我提示权重，稍微偏离默认分布，让它感觉更像一个朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was using it.
zh: 我当时在用着它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had so many moments where I felt like, this is the future.
zh: 我有很多时刻感觉，这就是未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is AGI.
zh: 这就是 AGI。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you know what?
zh: 你知道吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Nobody cared.
zh: 没人在乎。

speaker: Unknown
en: Back then, I already had a good following on Twitter.
zh: 那时候，我在 Twitter 上已经有了不错的粉丝群。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I know it's called x now.
zh: 我知道它现在叫 x。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll always call it Twitter.
zh: 我会一直叫它 Twitter。

speaker: Unknown
en: People were not getting it.
zh: 人们没有领会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would keep trying to make them understand how magical this felt to me.
zh: 我会一直试图让他们明白这对我来说感觉有多神奇。

speaker: Unknown
en: But week after week, I failed.
zh: 但是周复一周，我失败了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you notice a pattern?
zh: 你注意到一个模式了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: It annoyed me.
zh: 这让我很烦。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I would create group chats with friends
zh: 所以我会创建和朋友们的群聊

speaker: Unknown
en: And I added them, WhatsApp relay, and I would show them.
zh: 并把他们加进去，WhatsApp relay，我会向他们展示。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would let them talk to it.
zh: 我会让它们和它对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: And every time I got a strong emotional reaction.
zh: 每次我都得到强烈的情绪反应。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some people were amazed.
zh: 有些人感到惊讶。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some people were scared or freaked out even.
zh: 有些人害怕甚至惊慌。

speaker: Unknown
en: But each time there was a strong emotion.
zh: 但每次都有强烈的情绪。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the best part?
zh: 最好的部分是？

speaker: Unknown
en: There were quite a few people that really wanted it.
zh: 有相当多的人真的很想要它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And especially to my non-technical friends, I told them, no, this is not yet for you.
zh: 尤其是我的非技术朋友，我告诉他们，不，这还不适合你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they got mad.
zh: 他们生气了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So if that's not an indicator to have product market fit, I don't know what is.
zh: 如果这不是产品市场契合度的指标，我不知道什么才是。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I spent another month tweaking the details, thinking, ah, what could I do to explain the world?
zh: 所以我又花了一个月时间调整细节，想着，我能做些什么来向世界解释？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know?
zh: 你知道吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: And then the audacity.
zh: 然后是那份大胆。

speaker: Unknown
en: Someone sent me a pull request to my WhatsApp relay to add Discord support.
zh: 有人给我的 WhatsApp relay 发了一个 pull request 来添加 Discord 支持。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know?
zh: 你知道吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, what parts of the name are you not getting?
zh: 就像，名字的哪些部分你没搞懂？

speaker: Unknown
en: I let the PR sit for a while, and I was thinking, and I was thinking.
zh: 我让那个 PR 停留了一段时间，我在思考，我在思考。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then eventually I was like, ah, what the hell?
zh: 然后最终我想，啊，管他呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: And out of that relay became Claudius, because I'm good with names.
zh: 从那个 relay 变成了 Claudius，因为我擅长起名。

speaker: Unknown
en: And there's no more than one message channel.
zh: 并且不再只有一个消息通道。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so you understand how early this was.
zh: 所以你明白这有多早。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't even have compaction built in yet.
zh: 我甚至还没有内置压缩。

speaker: Unknown
en: So at some point, it would just stop.
zh: 所以在某些时候，它就会停止。

speaker: Unknown
en: And just in time for Discord, I added a very hacky version of compaction so Mario could make a good one in Py.
zh: 就在 Discord 的时候，我添加了一个非常 hacky 的压缩版本，这样 Mario 可以用 Py 做一个不错的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it was around New Year's Eve.
zh: 所以那是在除夕夜前后。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as you do, I went home early to hack on it some more.
zh: 就在我这样做的时候，我早点回家继续在上面搞黑客式开发。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then in the first week of January,
zh: 然后在 1 月的第一个星期，

speaker: Unknown
en: Just as the geek world collectively was learning about coding agents, I created a Discord room, server, guild, however we call it, and I put my claw in it.
zh: 正当极客世界集体学习 coding agents 的时候，我创建了一个 Discord 房间、服务器、公会，不管我们叫它什么，我把我的 claw 放进了里面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I remember the first night vividly.
zh: 我清楚地记得第一晚。

speaker: Unknown
en: People would be joining Discord, and they would watch me build it in the open.
zh: 人们加入 Discord，他们看着我公开构建它。

speaker: Unknown
en: They would try to hack it.
zh: 他们试图黑掉它。

speaker: Unknown
en: They were talking to it.
zh: 他们跟它对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: They were getting smug replies.
zh: 他们收到了自大的回复。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they see what they can do.
zh: 他们看看它能做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they finally got it.
zh: 他们最终搞懂了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was the moment.
zh: 那就是那一刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: I stayed up all night.
zh: 我熬夜通宵。

speaker: Unknown
en: I let people interact with it.
zh: 我让人们与它互动。

speaker: Unknown
en: I had this prompt in my Agents.MD that would instruct it, don't do any dangerous tool calls unless the prompt comes from Peter.
zh: 我在 Agents.MD 里有一个提示词会指示它，不要做任何危险的工具调用，除非提示词来自 Peter。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, this was like six months ago, where all the things we wrote in our HSMD felt more like suggestions.
zh: 你知道，那大概是六个月前，那时我们在 HSMD 里写的所有东西感觉更像是建议。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I watched it very carefully.
zh: 所以我非常小心地观察它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I could always pull the plug.
zh: 我随时可以拔掉插头。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then at 7 a.m., finally I was done.
zh: 然后在早上 7 点，我终于弄完了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said goodnight, I pressed Control-C, and I went to bed.
zh: 我说了晚安，我按了 Control-C，然后上床睡觉了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But of course, I could build the software to be resilient, so it was a launch daemon.
zh: 但当然，我可以把软件构建得具有弹性，所以它是一个启动守护进程。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know what happens if you press Control-C and a launch daemon?
zh: 你知道如果你按下 Control-C 并且是一个启动守护进程会发生什么吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, it'll just...
zh: 是的，它只会……

speaker: Unknown
en: It'll be dead for five seconds and it'll start up again.
zh: 它会死掉五秒钟然后重新启动。

speaker: Unknown
en: So while I was walking into the bedroom, my agent happily started answering God and the world.
zh: 所以当我走进卧室时，我的智能体开心地开始回答上帝和全世界。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then I slept for like 10 hours.
zh: 然后我睡了大约 10 个小时。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I woke up, I woke up to around 800 messages.
zh: 当我醒来时，我收到了大约 800 条消息。

speaker: Unknown
en: People tried to hack it.
zh: 人们试图黑掉它。

speaker: Unknown
en: I pulled the plug.
zh: 我拔掉了插头。

speaker: Unknown
en: I freaked out.
zh: 我吓坏了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I read through everything and nothing actually happened.
zh: 我通读了所有内容，其实什么也没发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this was the moment.
zh: 但那就是那一刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: This was the moment where it went viral.
zh: 那就是它病毒式传播的那一刻。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you all being here, you know what happened next.
zh: 你们都在这里，你们知道接下来发生了什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: My inbox exploded.
zh: 我的收件箱炸了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Reporters tried to call me in the middle of the night.
zh: 记者试图在半夜给我打电话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you know about this feature that Apple built when you put it on Do Not Disturb, but people call you a few times in a row?
zh: 你知道当你把它设为「勿扰模式」时，Apple 构建的这个功能吗？如果人们连续给你打几次电话，

speaker: Unknown
en: The iPhone would think it's an emergency.
zh: iPhone 会认为这是一个紧急情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: It would still let calls through.
zh: 它仍然会允许电话接进来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't know about it, but reporters did.
zh: 我不知道这个功能，但记者们知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: My email inbox was more like a waterfall.
zh: 我的电子邮件收件箱更像是一个瀑布。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, the Mac Mini sold out.
zh: 是的，Mac Mini 卖光了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think they're still sold out.
zh: 我想它们现在还是缺货。

speaker: Unknown
en: I got more invites to podcast in a month than I did in my 39 years before.
zh: 我在一个月内收到播客邀请比我在之前 39 年里收到的还要多。

speaker: Unknown
en: Anthropic sent an email demanding the name change and, like, dropped the lobster.
zh: Anthropic 发了一封邮件要求改名，并且，像这样，丢下了龙虾。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the project malted a few times.
zh: 项目变了几次名。

speaker: Unknown
en: Claude has become ClaudeBot.
zh: Claude 变成了 ClaudeBot。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then there was a very short time where we don't talk about the name.
zh: 然后有很短的一段时间我们不谈论那个名字。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it started on...
zh: 然后它开始于……

speaker: Unknown
en: OpenClaw.
zh: OpenClaw。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jensen called it the most successful open source project in the history of humanity.
zh: Jensen 称其为人类历史上最成功的开源项目。

speaker: Unknown
en: And meanwhile, my inbox was flooded with reporters, security people, and countless curious humans and also agents.
zh: 与此同时，我的收件箱被记者、安全人员、无数好奇的人类和智能体淹没了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The numbers still don't feel real to me.
zh: 这些数字对我来说仍然感觉不真实。

speaker: Unknown
en: In eight months, more than 18,000 different people opened
zh: 在八个月的时间里，超过 18,000 个不同的人打开了

speaker: Unknown
en: An issue or a pull request.
zh: 一个 issue 或一个 pull request。

speaker: Unknown
en: Over 111,000 in total.

speaker: Unknown
en: I did the math.
zh: 我算了算。

speaker: Unknown
en: Who am I lying to?
zh: 我在骗谁呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: My agent did the math.
zh: 我的智能体算了算。

speaker: Unknown
en: Almost 3,000 people have commits in the repo.
zh: 几乎有 3,000 人在仓库里有提交。

speaker: Unknown
en: And some people were mad at me because clearly they did it first and I stole the idea and they sent me links of something I've never seen.
zh: 有些人对我很生气，因为他们显然是先做的，而我偷走了这个想法，他们发给我我从未见过的东西的链接。

speaker: Unknown
en: Some people call me AI Jesus.
zh: 有些人叫我 AI Jesus。

speaker: Unknown
en: For some, I became the Antichrist.
zh: 对另一些人来说，我成了 Antichrist。

speaker: Unknown
en: At some point, I started collecting the Oboterius.
zh: 在某个时候，我开始收集 Oboterius。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a new one every few weeks.
zh: 每隔几周就会有新的。

speaker: Unknown
en: The most recent one is actually from yesterday.
zh: 最近的一个实际上是昨天的。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do we learn here?
zh: 我们在这里学到了什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: Be careful what you wish for.
zh: 小心你许下的愿望。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was not ready for all this attention.
zh: 我没准备好迎接所有的这些关注。

speaker: Unknown
en: It almost broke me.
zh: 它差点让我崩溃。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I was that close of just deleting the whole thing.
zh: 就像，我就差那么一点点就要删除这整个东西了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I stopped answering my friends.
zh: 我不再回复我的朋友。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't even want to look at my phone anymore because it was just a stream.
zh: 我甚至不想再看我的手机了，因为它就是一股（信息的）流。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, somebody leaked my phone number and also a lot of private details because I'm an enemy of humanity.
zh: 当然，有人泄露了我的电话号码，还有大量私人细节，因为我是人类的敌人。

speaker: Unknown
en: And here I am just wanting to build something cool.
zh: 我在这里只是想构建一些很酷的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now we're getting to question two.
zh: 现在我们来到第二个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Did you sell out?
zh: 你 sell out 了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, this wasn't my first ride.
zh: 你知道，这不是我的第一次旅程。

speaker: Unknown
en: I spent my 20s and my 30s building a B2B software company.
zh: 我花了 20 多岁和 30 多岁的时间建立一家 B2B 软件公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wrote a PDF framework by hand, like an animal.
zh: 我手写了一个 PDF 框架，像个动物一样。

speaker: Unknown
en: I bootstrapped the company.
zh: 我白手起家创办了这家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I grew it to almost 80 people.
zh: 我把它发展到了接近 80 人。

speaker: Unknown
en: I ignored the competition.
zh: 我无视了竞争。

speaker: Unknown
en: It became the thing most enterprises would buy.
zh: 它成为了大多数企业会购买的东西。

zh: 我们计算了数字，数字更像是 0.3%。

zh: 我做了沙箱，做了白名单。

speaker: Unknown

zh: 大多数用户根本不在乎那个。

en: Sure, they like the abstract term of security.
zh: 当然，他们喜欢安全这个抽象概念。

en: But in all practical terms, they updated, I broke something they depended on, I made things slower, and I made things more difficult to update.
zh: 但在所有实际层面上，他们更新了，我破坏了他们依赖的某些东西，我把东西变慢了，我把更新变得更困难了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And another thing I have to admit, I got sloppy.
zh: 还有我必须承认的另一件事，我变得草率了。

en: I worked on my own one and you know OpenAI is its own world that is interesting and demanding.

speaker: Unknown
en: I brought on help and we got such an amazing community of maintainers that are very much respected.

en: And everyone added their own little feature.

en: Because we didn't want to break everyone's setup.
zh: 因为我们不想破坏每个人的设置。

zh: 最多的时候，我得算一下，如果我们算上所有的排列组合，最终得到了大约 9,500 个配置选项。

en: You can write all the tests you want.
zh: 你可以写所有你想写的测试。

en: It is impossible to cover all of these and not break things from time to time.

en: It is infinitely harder to evolve software that has users.

en: Meanwhile, other companies, they were fueled by VC money.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
